title: Bind internal bot authentication to one authoritative runtime tenant
out_of_scope: deploy / cloud / database / Stripe / WhatsApp / production operations

getAccessibleClientSlugs.bot_principal: staff_user_id===luna-bot-internal → [bound client_slug] or [] if unbound; never all baseline

dispatchStaffBotRouteWithEffectiveTenant.signature: dispatchStaffBotRouteWithEffectiveTenant({ user, authMode, effectiveClientSlug, staffAuthRequired, canAccessClient, handler, onDenied })
dispatchStaffBotRouteWithEffectiveTenant.behavior: Propagate principal into handler only when principal can access route effective tenant; on deny handler_called=false
dispatchStaffBotRouteWithEffectiveTenant.open_mode: staffAuthRequired=false / auth_mode=open / null user → allow (dev bypass preserved)

guarded_route_inventory.symmetric_gate_note: Gate is tenant-agnostic; RED covers Wolfhouse-token→Sunset effective and Sunset-token→Wolfhouse effective with zero handler calls. Wolfhouse has no path-forced /staff/bot/wolfhouse/* inventory; body/query selection remains B07.

wolfhouse_staff_api.LUNA_BOT_CLIENT_SLUG: set to this deployment tenant slug (e.g. wolfhouse-somo)
wolfhouse_staff_api.DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG: optional compat only when nonempty and equal; must not conflict

sunset_staff_api.LUNA_BOT_CLIENT_SLUG: set to this deployment tenant slug (e.g. sunset)
sunset_staff_api.DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG: optional compat only when nonempty and equal; must not conflict

rollout_env_requirement.note: Each Staff API runtime that enables LUNA_BOT_INTERNAL_TOKEN must set LUNA_BOT_CLIENT_SLUG (or a consistent nonempty DEFAULT_CLIENT_SLUG). Missing/invalid/conflicting values fail closed with 503 on bot-token auth.

residual_risk.summary: Generic /staff/bot/* handlers may still trust body/query client_slug independently of the bound principal. 15E closes principal bind + force-tenant route dispatch ACL; body/query selection is unchanged.
